office_does: One of the 25th District's two members of the Washington House, voting on state law and the state budgets for a two-year term.
race_blurb: Two Puyallup School Board veterans meet: first-term Republican Michael Keaton, a former F-16 pilot, and Democratic school director David Berg. Keaton runs against taxes and spending and pressed for the I-2081 parents' bill of rights; Berg runs on public education and workers' rights and is skeptical of AI and data centers.

candidates.summary: First-term representative, Puyallup School Board member 2015-2023 and retired Air Force F-16 pilot, running against high taxes and spending.
highlights: Pledges to keep fighting 'reckless government spending and high taxes' [S1]
Voted against ESSB 6346 and the 2025 B&O and services tax bills [S6][S9][S10]
Offered amendments to require schools to support the I-2081 parents' bill of rights [S13][S14]
Endorsed by the Association of Washington Business [S19]

taxes.basis: Campaigns against high taxes and for the no-new-taxes Save Washington plan; voted against ESSB 6346, ESHB 2081 and ESSB 5814.

spending.basis: Runs against 'reckless government spending' and promotes a budget that lives within its means.

housing.basis: Says unnecessary bureaucracy adds costs to building a home.

safety.basis: Emphasizes holding people accountable and the costs of shoplifting and crime.

experience.basis: One term in the House plus eight years on the school board, against a challenger who also holds local office.

parental-rights.basis: Sought to require schools to support I-2081 and to remove OSPI sanctions, voted against ESHB 1296, and cites parental engagement on the school board.

candidates.summary: Puyallup School District director since 2021 and longtime gifted-education and PTA advocate, running on public education, workers' rights and economic opportunity.
highlights: Prioritizes public education, workers' rights and economic stability for working people [S1]
Calls himself an AI skeptic and wants data centers to pay the costs they create [S5]
Defended a teacher-recommended curriculum against board objections in 2021 [S7]
Endorsed by the WSLC, the Washington Education Association and Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates [S3][S8][S9]

tech.basis: AI skeptic who wants data centers to bear their power and water costs, bias review of classroom AI, and limits on AI in hiring decisions.

climate.basis: Wants to revisit requiring large data centers to use new renewable or non-emitting electricity.

experience.basis: School director challenging an incumbent legislator; has local but no legislative office.

social.basis: Defended DEI work including gender identity and LGBTQ+ inclusion; endorsed by Planned Parenthood and Stonewall Democrats.

parental-rights.basis: Defended teacher-led curriculum adoption against board objections, while acknowledging parents want more input.

housing.basis: Endorsed by the Washington Housing Alliance; no stated housing position.
